chapters.title: The invisible surface
chapters.speech: Two plastic films may look identical until something meets their surface. We changed the outermost layer of poly lactic acid, then tested how it behaved.

chapters.title: A baseline for the experiment
chapters.speech: Untreated PLA had a measured water contact angle of seventy point two degrees. In this experiment, that helped establish the reference surface for comparison.
chapters.source: 2021 paper Table 1; water contact angle 70.2 (±1.6) degrees.

chapters.title: Plasma changes the contact layer
chapters.speech: Cold plasma alters the film's contact surface. The next question is whether new surface chemistry can be introduced, rather than merely depositing molecules on an unprepared polymer.
chapters.source: 2021 paper methods and discussion; illustrative plasma activation mechanism, not experimental footage.

chapters.title: Two different grafting reagents
chapters.speech: The study compared ascorbic acid with fumaric acid after plasma treatment. Their different surface responses became a test of what chemical modification had actually achieved.
chapters.source: Original 2021 grafting study; ASA versus FA treatments.

chapters.title: Proof must be chemical
chapters.speech: Contact angle alone cannot establish molecular attachment. The investigators also used X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy to compare surface chemistry after plasma exposure and grafting.
chapters.source: 2021 source paper Figure 4: XPS spectra; genuine original published figure.

chapters.title: The wetting changed
chapters.speech: The measured water contact angle fell from seventy point two degrees untreated to fifty five point one after plasma treatment, and forty nine point six after fumaric acid grafting.
chapters.source: 2021 paper Table 1 water contact angles and Figure 1 wettability; actual numeric values.

chapters.title: The peel experiment
chapters.speech: In the original peel test, the untreated laminate resisted separation at seventy four newtons per meter. Fumaric acid grafting after plasma treatment reached two hundred eleven.
chapters.source: 2021 paper Figure 8; original figures indicate ~74.4 and 211 N/m.

chapters.title: The control answers the question
chapters.speech: Adding fumaric acid without plasma gave only eighty seven newtons per meter. The strongest result required the treatment sequence. That is evidence for a surface process, not a universal packaging claim.
chapters.source: 2021 paper Figure 8: untreated + FA approximately 87.2; plasma + FA 211 N/m.
